# Broadband for the new flat

I move into Flat 2, 8 Weir Street on 1 March. Two offers, both on an 18-month contract.

## A: Larkfield Fibre, £27 a month

- Speed: up to 500 Mbps
- Installation: free
- Router: included
- Total over the contract: £486
- Price rises during the contract: none

## B: Tern Broadband, £21 a month

- Speed: up to 300 Mbps
- Installation: £120, charged only if the engineer's visit finds that the flat's existing line cannot carry the service and a new cable has to be run to the street; otherwise free
- Router: included
- Total over the contract: £378, before any installation charge
- Price rises during the contract: none
